title: refAInery agent personality v1
description: Self-contained personality configuration, not a running agent or model selection. Must not contain credentials.

id.description: Stable personality identity, unique within the loaded configuration. File basename must equal this ID; the loader enforces both rules.

instructions.description: Embedded instructions, preserved without trimming or rewriting. Markdown is allowed. Instructions are not a permissions boundary.

availableTools.description: Required explicit allowlist of server catalog tool IDs. Empty means no tools. Catalog membership and role/policy authorization are validated by the backend, not this structural schema.
